title: The Audit Log records a rule type change and the values typed after it
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, three ranges, pricing one new category made for this test, tier A on Margin % 15 in every range.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Pick % Off in tier A's rule picker.
  5. Type 10 in tier A's first range.
  6. Type 12 in tier A's second range.
  7. Type 15 in tier A's last range.
  8. Click Save.
  9. Open the page's three-dot menu.
  10. Click Audit Log.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The grid is in edit.

Step 4:

  • Tier A's three ranges are % Off and empty.

Step 5:

  • Tier A's first range reads 10.

Step 6:

  • Tier A's second range reads 12.

Step 7:

  • Tier A's last range reads 15.

Step 8:

  • The grid saves and returns to view.

Step 9:

  • The menu lists Audit Log.

Step 10:

  • A dialog titled "Audit Log:" and matrix A's name opens.
  • The newest entry is one entry for this save.
  • It reads tier A's name followed by ": rule type Margin % → % Off; 3 range values changed".
